name: vllm_ggml_mul_mat_a8
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench vLLM test_ggml_mul_mat_a8.py. GGML Q4_0 quantized weight x fp32 activation matmul: W is a uint8 tensor holding (row//32) Q4_0 blocks per matrix row, each block = 18 bytes (2-byte fp16 scale set to 1.0 = 0x3C00 little-endian, then 16 bytes of 4-bit values); X is fp32 (batch, m); quant_type=2 (Q4_0); row=n logical width. W has a fixed byte layout so it is built by gen_inputs (num_qblocks derived from declared W width // 18); X is plain randn. Reference calls _custom_ops.ggml_mul_mat_a8 and returns its result. Default comparison over the full fp32 output. Requires vLLM at eval time.
